chunks: He said: "If I ask you anything again after this, then do not keep me with you. You have my apology."

key_terms.بَعْدَهَا: after this (referring to the previous events)
key_terms.تُصَاحِبْنِي: keep me with you / accompany me

ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to Khidr regarding their future companionship?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the pivotal moment where Khidr establishes the boundary between Moses' active inquiry (ta'abbud) and his eventual acceptance of the unseen wisdom (ta'wil). It underscores the scholarly principle that while questioning is a virtue, persistent interrogation without grasping the underlying reality can lead to the termination of spiritual instruction.
